items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They didn't want Chris Cal? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, no, Chris, not a Capcom. No. No. No.

ctx.x: Well, they played, they played, they played the modern music, now. He only had a band on the counter on the style of the lombardo. You see. And the people that go into the root garden was the type of people. It wasn't, you know, the people that wanted all these junk, you know. Blues and all that stuff. They wanted, you know, like the old people.
Well, no, Chris, not a Capcom. No. No. No.
